categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of photovoltaic (PV) tinned copper foil welding tape (also called PV module welding tape). The products are divided into two main categories: interconnection tape (used to connect PV cells) and busbar tape (used to connect PV cell strings). The company also has other business segments including technology services and new energy operations through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced production technologies including pressure rolling and annealing integration technology, copper strip heat treatment technology, corrosion-resistant low-temperature solder formulation technology, high-speed tinning technology, and segmented pressure rolling and tinning technology. The company employs automated production lines with high automation levels to ensure stable product performance. Production follows ISO 9001:2015 quality management system standards with multiple quality control checkpoints including self-inspection, specialized inspection, patrol inspection, and sampling inspection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major photovoltaic module manufacturers including Trina Solar, LONGi Green Energy, Tongwei Co., Ltd., Tian He Light Energy, Canadian Solar, JinkoSolar, and others. These customers are among the world's leading PV module manufacturers with significant market share. The company's products are used in PV module assembly and are ultimately applied in photovoltaic power generation systems for both utility-scale and distributed applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Suzhou and Anhui. Domestically, it serves customers across China's major PV manufacturing regions. Internationally, the company exports to multiple countries with overseas sales representing approximately 8.28% of total revenue in 2023. The company has established subsidiaries including operations in Shanghai for new energy business development.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the photovoltaic industry supply chain as a materials supplier. It sources raw materials (copper and tin alloys) from upstream suppliers and supplies finished PV welding tape products to downstream PV module manufacturers, who then incorporate these products into complete photovoltaic modules for end-use applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing high-performance PV welding tape products adapted to emerging battery technologies including TOPCon, HJT (heterojunction), and xBC (back-contact) cells. R&D priorities include developing ultra-fine, ultra-soft, ultra-thin, and ultra-narrow welding tape products, as well as special-structure irregular welding tape. The company is investing in new product development for non-welding products and exploring new materials and new energy sectors to build a diversified product portfolio and second growth curve.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of photovoltaic tinned copper foil welding tape products to PV module manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of the goods, which typically occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company uses a make-to-order production model based on customer orders, with revenue recognized at a single point in time when goods are delivered and verified by customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest and most important suppliers in the photovoltaic welding tape segment. According to the China Photovoltaic Industry Association, the company's market share of PV tinned copper foil welding tape output ranks among the top in 2023. The company maintains competitive advantages through advanced technology, superior product quality, strong brand recognition, and established relationships with leading global PV module manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 2.762 billion yuan, representing 37.36% growth compared to 2022 (2.011 billion yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 151.3 million yuan in 2023, up 50.69% from 100.4 million yuan in 2022. The company has shown consistent growth trajectory with revenue increasing from 1.239 billion yuan in 2021. Total assets reached 3.104 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 42.20% from 2.183 billion yuan at year-end 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing technology, superior product quality, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive customer service. Products are certified by multiple international standards (TUV, SGS, national quality inspection centers) and comply with ISO 9001:2015 quality management standards. The company offers customized solutions for different PV cell technologies and provides full-cycle technical support. The company's brand 'YourBuddy' is recognized as a famous trademark in Jiangsu Province, and products have been awarded 'Suzhou Famous Brand' and 'Jiangsu Famous Brand' designations, reflecting strong market recognition and customer trust.
